description: Secured parking spaces and boxes for bicycles and cargo bikes managed by Cycloparking (Brussels-Capital Region) is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by cycloparking.brussels. List of secured parking spaces and boxes for bicycles and cargo bikes, managed by Cycloparking (parking.brussels project) in the Brussels-Capital Region Cycloparking develops and runs the web platform cycloparking.brussels. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Parking, Parking, mobility, soft mobility, active mobility, bicycle. The portal shows 911 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
